overview_description.description: Edfundo is a fintech and edtech startup that provides a financial education and money-management platform for children and teenagers. The company combines a mobile app, financial learning resources, and a prepaid debit card to help young users develop responsible money habits while allowing parents to supervise and guide their spending.
